# 怎样让一个物理控制器同时接受全身轨迹、VR 头手、任意关节关键帧和文本等不同输入？

> **当前答案：** MaskedMimic 先训练完整未来目标的物理跟踪教师，再用 DAgger、结构化随机遮罩和 conditional VAE，把多种输入统一成显式的部分目标补全接口。它只覆盖训练过的遮罩/条件分布，不自动处理矛盾目标、长时规划、传感器偏置或真实机器人部署。

## 关键术语

- 惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）

## 适用机器人

- Simulated humanoid characters in the paper; real robots require separate dynamics and safety evidence

## 适用模拟器

- ProtoMotions-supported simulation with matched scene, mask, and observation contracts

## 控制器与方法

- fully constrained motion tracker
- DAgger-distilled conditional-VAE partial-goal controller

## 适用环境

- simulated full-body, VR, keyframe, text, terrain, and object-conditioned character control

## 成立假设

- A fully constrained teacher can track the source motion distribution.
- Deployment command/missingness patterns are represented by the versioned structured-mask distribution.

## 排查与验证

- 先核对适用机器人、模拟器、控制器、环境和成立假设，再沿下方证据定位复核原始实验或实现。

## 结果

- MaskedMimic 先训练完整未来目标的物理跟踪教师，再用 DAgger、结构化随机遮罩和 conditional VAE，把多种输入统一成显式的部分目标补全接口。它只覆盖训练过的遮罩/条件分布，不自动处理矛盾目标、长时规划、传感器偏置或真实机器人部署。

## 限制

- A fully constrained teacher can track the source motion distribution.
- Deployment command/missingness patterns are represented by the versioned structured-mask distribution.

## 证据

- [MaskedMimic: Unified Physics-Based Character Control Through Masked Motion Inpainting](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.14393v1>) — `support/primary`；Figures 3 and 5; Tables 1-6; Sections 4-9；Defines teacher-to-partial-goal distillation and shows dense/sparse/multimodal results plus decisive structured-mask and prior ablations.
- [NVlabs/ProtoMotions MaskedMimic implementation](<https://github.com/NVlabs/ProtoMotions/tree/5241478e35a7dcf5d1455dac2df0486d5e7f440a>) — `support/primary`；masked_mimic_control.py, masked_mimic_model.py, obs/masked_mimic.py, and tests at 5241478；Exposes mask sampling/shifting, conditional-VAE student, sparse observations, and component tests.
